_readme: Postdoctoral fellowships, programmes and positions from OFFICIAL sources only. Same rules as phd.json (statusOverride null|varies|unconfirmed|closed; never invent dates or amounts). Checked weekly — see AGENT.md.

programmes.title: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowships (MSCA-PF)
programmes.summary: Europe’s main individual postdoctoral fellowship: European Fellowships bring researchers of any nationality to a host in Europe for 1–2 years; Global Fellowships send European researchers abroad and back.
programmes.location: Universities, research centres and companies in EU and Horizon Europe associated countries
eligibility: Apply jointly with a host organisation.
International mobility to or between EU Member States/Associated Countries (European Fellowships).
Global Fellowships are for European nationals or long-term residents.
programmes.funding: EU-funded fellowship covering the researcher’s living, mobility and family costs plus research costs (unit costs set in the call).

dates.deadlineNote: The 2026 call ran 9 April – 9 September 2026 (results February 2027). The next call’s dates are not yet published.

procedure: Find a host supervisor in Europe.
Write the proposal with your host and submit it on the EU Funding & Tenders portal by the call deadline.

verification.notes: From the European Commission MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2026 page and REA.

programmes.title: EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowships
programmes.summary: Two-year fellowships for life scientists moving to a new country for their postdoc, with salary or stipend, relocation allowance and support for parents; applications are accepted all year with set cut-off dates.
programmes.location: Laboratories in EMBC Member States (or worldwide for EMBC nationals)
eligibility: Must change country; not in the country where you did your PhD; not more than 6 months already in the host country.
Apply within two years of your PhD award (or provide the degree before starting).
Nationals of non-EMBC countries can apply to labs in EMBC Member States.
programmes.nationalities: Any nationality for host labs in EMBC Member States.
programmes.funding: Salary or stipend, relocation allowance and support for fellows with children (rates in EMBO’s contract-rate document).

dates.deadlineNote: Hard deadline 22 January 2027, 14:00 CET; applications accepted year-round for later cut-offs. Re-applications not permitted from the Autumn 2027 round.

procedure: Agree a project with a host lab in a different country.
Apply online before the cut-off.

verification.notes: From the EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowships page and FAQs.

programmes.title: Human Frontier Science Program (HFSP) Postdoctoral Fellowships
programmes.summary: Three-year fellowships for life scientists of any nationality to move to a new country and a new research field.
programmes.location: Host labs in a country other than your nationality and PhD country
eligibility: Anyone of any nationality; not in your country of nationality or PhD/first-postdoc country.
PhD conferred within 3 years before the submission deadline (or by the start).
New research topic different from your PhD; at least one lead-author publication or preprint.
programmes.funding: Three-year fellowship (amounts in the HFSP guidelines).

dates.deadlineNote: The 2027 fellowships call required a letter of intent by 5 May 2026 and invited full proposals by 24 September 2026. The next call dates are not yet published.

procedure: Submit a letter of intent in the spring call.
If invited, submit the full proposal in September.

verification.notes: From the HFSP 2027 Postdoctoral Fellowships call summary (EPFL Memento).

programmes.title: Humboldt Research Fellowship for postdocs
programmes.summary: €3,000 a month for international postdocs to do research with a host in Germany for 6–24 months.
programmes.location: Universities and research institutions in Germany
eligibility: Doctorate within the last four years (extensions for career breaks).
Not a German national (with exceptions).
A host in Germany who provides a mentoring agreement and statement.
programmes.funding: €3,000 a month plus additional benefits.
programmes.duration: 6–24 months (can be split into up to three stays within three years)

dates.deadlineNote: Three calls a year (opening 15 March, 15 July and 15 November); the current call reached its application limit. The next call opens 15 March 2027.

procedure: Agree your project with a host in Germany.
Apply online when a call opens; your host uploads the required documents.

verification.notes: From the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation fellowship page.

programmes.title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowship for Research in Japan (Standard)
programmes.provider: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
programmes.summary: 12–24 month postdoctoral fellowships in Japan with JPY 362,000 a month; applications are submitted by a host researcher in Japan.
programmes.location: Universities and research institutes in Japan
eligibility: Citizen of a country with diplomatic relations with Japan.
Doctorate within six years of the fellowship start (on or after 2 April 2021 for FY2027).
A host researcher in Japan submits the application.
programmes.nationalities: Countries with diplomatic relations with Japan (includes Pakistan).
programmes.funding: JPY 362,000 a month maintenance allowance and JPY 200,000 settling-in allowance.

dates.deadlineNote: Host-institution deadline 23 April 2027 (arrival 1 Sep – 30 Nov 2027). Host institutions may set earlier internal deadlines.

procedure: Find a host researcher in Japan.
Prepare the application; the host submits it via their institution before the deadline.

verification.notes: From the JSPS FY2027 application guidelines (Standard).

programmes.title: Royal Society Newton International Fellowships
programmes.summary: Two-year fellowships for non-UK early-career researchers of any nationality to work at a UK institution, worth up to £280,000.
programmes.fields: Natural sciences, engineering, medicine (see scheme notes)
eligibility: Based outside the UK and not a UK citizen.
PhD awarded (or defended) by the closing date; no more than five years’ full-time postdoctoral experience.
programmes.funding: Up to £280,000 over two years.

dates.deadlineNote: The scheme is currently closed; the next round’s dates are not yet listed (the 2026 round closed in March 2026).

procedure: Agree a project with a UK host.
Apply when the round opens.

verification.notes: From the Royal Society Newton International Fellowships page.

warnings: The former Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships are no longer offered (closed February 2025).
International applicants need a current or past doctoral/postdoctoral link to a Canadian institution.
programmes.title: Canada Postdoctoral Research Award (CPRA)
programmes.provider: NSERC, SSHRC and CIHR (Government of Canada)
programmes.summary: Canada’s harmonised tri-agency postdoctoral award: $70,000 a year for 24 months; up to 20% of awards go to international applicants who already have a link to a Canadian institution.
programmes.fields: Natural sciences and engineering, social sciences and humanities, health
eligibility: Degree completed no more than three years before 1 September of the application year (with exceptions).
International applicants must currently be registered in, or have completed, a doctorate at a Canadian institution, or be doing postdoctoral research at a Canadian institution.
programmes.nationalities: Canadians and international applicants with a Canadian doctoral or postdoctoral link (up to 20% of awards).

dates.deadlineNote: Deadlines: SSHRC 10 September, CIHR 16 September, NSERC 17 October; results by 31 March.

procedure: Check eligibility on the agency page for your field.
Apply by the agency deadline in the autumn.

verification.notes: From NSERC’s Canada Postdoctoral Research Award page.

warnings: Pakistani nationals cannot currently be considered (Associate Membership ceiling reached).
programmes.title: CERN Research Fellowship
programmes.summary: Postdoctoral fellowships at CERN in Geneva in physics, applied physics and engineering, with a net monthly stipend of CHF 7,004 or 7,425.
programmes.fields: Theoretical and experimental physics, applied physics and engineering, computing
eligibility: National of a CERN Member or Associate Member State (a few exceptions a year).
PhD (or within six months); up to 6 years’ post-PhD experience in physics, up to 3 years in applied sciences/engineering.
programmes.nationalities: CERN Member and Associate Member States; currently not open to Pakistani, Lithuanian, Latvian, Cypriot, Croatian or Turkish nationals.
programmes.funding: Net monthly stipend of CHF 7,004 or 7,425.

dates.deadlineNote: Each field recruits separately; check open Research Fellowship vacancies on CERN Careers.

procedure: Find an open Research Fellowship vacancy on CERN Careers.
Apply online; shortlisted candidates may be interviewed.

verification.notes: From CERN’s Research Fellowship page.

programmes.title: EMBL EIPOD-LinC Postdoctoral Fellowships
programmes.summary: EMBL’s interdisciplinary postdoctoral programme, open to researchers of all nationalities, with projects across EMBL sites and partner institutions.
programmes.location: EMBL sites (Heidelberg, Hamburg, Hinxton, Barcelona, Grenoble, Rome) and partners
programmes.fields: Life sciences, computational and interdisciplinary research
eligibility: PhD by the call deadline (defended counts).
Maximum eight years’ research experience since the PhD award.
Prior EMBL association no more than 12 months in the last 3 years.
programmes.funding: Postdoctoral fellowship at EMBL (terms in the Guide for Applicants).

dates.deadlineNote: Call closes 1 February 2027 at 23:59 CET; interviews 12 April 2027 by Zoom.

procedure: Read the Guide for Applicants and choose projects.
Apply online before 1 February 2027.

verification.notes: From EMBL’s EIPOD-LinC application page.

programmes.title: Ulam NAWA Programme (incoming researchers to Poland)
programmes.provider: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
programmes.summary: Funds 6–24 month stays of researchers from abroad, of any nationality or discipline, at Polish universities and institutes, with salaries of up to PLN 17,000 a month.
eligibility: Researchers from abroad regardless of age, discipline or country of origin.
A doctoral degree by the application deadline.
The Polish host institution submits the application.
programmes.funding: Remuneration up to PLN 17,000 a month (gross, full-time employment) plus research costs set in the call.

dates.deadlineNote: The 2026 call closed on 15 May 2026 (projects from 1 February 2027). The next call is not yet announced.

procedure: Agree a project with a host (inviting person) in Poland.
The host institution submits the application in the NAWA system.

verification.notes: From the NAWA Ulam 2026 call document.

programmes.title: RIKEN Special Postdoctoral Researcher (SPDR)
programmes.summary: Three-year postdoctoral positions at RIKEN in Japan for early-career researchers to pursue their own project, with ¥550,000 a month and a ¥1,000,000 yearly research budget.
programmes.fields: Natural sciences, engineering, mathematics, life sciences
eligibility: PhD awarded on or after 1 January 2021 (for FY2027), or by the hire date; exceptions for research lapses.
programmes.funding: ¥550,000 a month (insurance and taxes included) and a ¥1,000,000 research budget per year.

dates.deadlineNote: The FY2027 call closed on 9 April 2026 (start 1 April 2027). The FY2028 call has not been announced yet.

procedure: Agree a project with a RIKEN host laboratory.
Register and upload documents when the call opens (usually in spring).

verification.notes: From RIKEN’s SPDR FY2027 call page.

programmes.title: ISTA Fellow Postdoctoral Program
programmes.provider: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)
programmes.summary: Two-year postdoctoral contracts at ISTA near Vienna with a minimum salary of €73,500 gross, open internationally.
programmes.fields: All ISTA research groups except astrophysics
eligibility: PhD by the call deadline or before the fellowship start.
Not already employed at ISTA.
programmes.nationalities: No nationality requirement in the guide.
programmes.funding: Minimum €73,500 gross a year with full social security.

dates.deadlineNote: The 2026 call closed on 8 September 2026 (start between 15 Dec 2026 and 15 Jun 2027). The next call is not yet published.

procedure: Choose an ISTA host group.
Apply online when the call is open.

verification.notes: From ISTA’s ISTA Fellow page and 2026 Guide for Applicants.

programmes.title: KAUST Global Fellowship Program (postdoctoral)
programmes.provider: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
programmes.summary: Three-year research fellowships at KAUST for recent PhD graduates of all nationalities, selected in two stages (concept note, then invited full proposal).
eligibility: PhD within four calendar years (Call 2027: awarded January 2023 or later), or completed before the start.
All nationalities; must meet Saudi resident-status requirements.
programmes.funding: Fellowship at KAUST (benefits in the official guidelines).

dates.deadlineNote: Call 2027 concept notes were accepted 1 September – 1 October 2026; invited full proposals until 15 January 2027. Call 2028 dates are not yet published (Call 2027 opened on 1 September).

procedure: Submit a concept note and reference letters when the call opens (September).
If invited, submit a full proposal.

sources.label: KAUST Global Fellowship — how to apply

verification.notes: From KAUST Global Fellowship Program pages.

programmes.title: ARC Discovery Early Career Researcher Award (DECRA)
programmes.summary: Three-year awards that fund an early-career researcher’s salary and up to $50,000 a year in project costs at an Australian university.
programmes.fields: All fields except clinical medicine and dentistry (see guidelines)
eligibility: Outstanding early-career researchers (eligibility details in the grant guidelines on GrantConnect).
Applications are submitted through an eligible Australian organisation.
programmes.funding: Salary and on-costs plus up to $50,000 a year in project costs.

dates.deadlineNote: Check GrantConnect for the current DECRA opportunity and your university’s internal deadline.

procedure: Contact the research office of an Australian university willing to host you.
Apply through that university by its internal deadline.

verification.notes: From the Australian Research Council DECRA page.

warnings: Not eligible if you spent more than 12 months in Switzerland in the 3 years before the deadline, or more than 6 months at ETH Zurich, EPFL, an ETH-domain institute or the University of Zurich.
Competitive: ETH states a success rate of about 15–20%.

verification.notes: From the ETH Zurich Grants Office fellowship page.

programmes.title: ETH Postdoctoral Fellowships
programmes.summary: Two-year fellowships for early-career researchers who propose their own project with an ETH Zurich professor as mentor.
eligibility: PhD completed, or completed within 6 months of the deadline, and obtained no more than 2 years before the submission deadline.
At least one peer-reviewed publication, or a thesis prize.
Supported by an ETH Zurich professor who acts as mentor (one candidate per professor per round).
programmes.nationalities: All nationalities, subject to the Swiss mobility rule (see warnings).
programmes.funding: Total budget per year (including 15% social security): CHF 92,500 or 106,400 in year 1 and CHF 97,200 or 111,800 in year 2, depending on the rate that applies (see the official page).

dates.deadlineNote: Two deadlines a year: 1 March and 1 September, 17:00 Swiss time.

procedure: Find an ETH Zurich professor willing to mentor you and host your project.
Prepare your own research proposal with the mentor.
Submit by the 1 March or 1 September deadline as described by the ETH Grants Office.

sources.label: ETH Zurich Grants Office — ETH Fellowships

verification.notes: From the PIFI page of the CAS Institute of Physics. Funding amounts not stated there.

programmes.title: CAS President’s International Fellowship Initiative (PIFI)
programmes.summary: CAS fellowship scheme for international researchers at all career stages, including postdocs, hosted by a CAS research institute.
programmes.location: Chinese Academy of Sciences institutes, China
programmes.fields: All fields researched at CAS institutes
eligibility: Open to scientific research personnel worldwide at all career stages.
You need a host researcher at a CAS institute; individuals cannot apply directly.
programmes.funding: Not specified on the page we checked — confirm with your CAS host.
programmes.duration: Not specified on the page we checked.

dates.deadlineNote: Applications are accepted all year and reviewed in batches; review takes about 3 months.

procedure: Find a CAS researcher willing to host you.
Your host submits the application through the CAS ARP system.
Follow results and news on pifi.cas.cn.

warnings: Host-institution and other conditions are set in each year’s call — read it before applying.

verification.notes: From NWO’s Talent Programme page; no open Veni call was listed.

programmes.title: NWO Talent Programme — Veni
programmes.summary: Personal grant of up to €320,000 for researchers in the transition to independence, to carry out their own innovative research.
eligibility: PhD obtained no more than three years ago (see the call for exact rules).
Academic qualities that clearly exceed what is usual within your peer group.

dates.deadlineNote: One Veni round a year; the next call and its deadline were not published on the page we checked.

procedure: Two stages: a pre-application assessing you through a narrative CV with key output.
Then a full application assessing your research proposal and its scientific and/or societal impact.

warnings: Exceptions to the PhD window apply for parental leave, national service and long sick leave — see the FAQs.
programmes.title: “la Caixa” Junior Leader Postdoctoral Fellowships
programmes.summary: Three-year full-time postdoctoral fellowships in STEM at any university or research centre in Spain or Portugal, open to researchers of any nationality.
programmes.location: Universities and research centres in Spain and Portugal
eligibility: PhD (thesis defence) obtained between two and seven years before the call deadline; no age limit.
Incoming call: you must not have lived or worked in Spain (or Portugal, for a Portuguese host) for more than 12 months in the three years before the deadline.
Retaining call: for researchers already in Spain; if you have lived in Spain more than three years you may apply to Retaining for a Spanish host or Incoming for a Portuguese host.
programmes.funding: €64,000 a year for labour costs; the host must pay a minimum gross salary of €47,000 a year.

dates.deadlineNote: Call dates change every year; the foundation offers email alerts for when the next call opens.

procedure: Choose a host university or research centre in Spain or Portugal.
Check whether you fit the Incoming or the Retaining call.
Apply online during the call, following the rules for participation.

verification.notes: From the “la Caixa” Foundation call and FAQ pages. Next call dates not yet published.

warnings: Late or incomplete applications are not considered.
programmes.title: Wallenberg–NTU Presidential Postdoctoral Fellowship
programmes.summary: One year at NTU Singapore plus one year with a WASP research group in Sweden, in AI and related fields.
programmes.location: NTU Singapore and Swedish universities in WASP
programmes.fields: AI, machine learning, big data and analytics, software and security, mobility and autonomy
eligibility: PhD (or equivalent) obtained within the last 5 years.
Readiness for an independent research career and a realistic research proposal.
Available to start no later than 31 December 2027.
programmes.nationalities: Not restricted on the official page.
programmes.funding: At NTU: salary up to SGD 80,000 a year plus a research grant up to SGD 100,000, relocation allowance and housing grant. In Sweden: WASP’s standard postdoc support package.

dates.deadlineNote: Applications close 31 December 2026, 23:59 Singapore time; referee reports due 7 January 2027.

procedure: Prepare a cover letter, CV with publications, transcript or PhD certificate, a 2-page research proposal (NTU template) and your top 3 publications.
Arrange two referees, one of them your PhD supervisor.
Apply through the NTU online application portal.

verification.notes: From NTU’s Presidential Postdoctoral Fellowship page.

warnings: Candidates holding any UC Berkeley position during the competition cannot be nominated.
programmes.title: Miller Research Fellowships (UC Berkeley)
programmes.provider: Miller Institute for Basic Research in Science, UC Berkeley
programmes.summary: Three-year independent postdoctoral fellowships in basic science at UC Berkeley, by nomination.
eligibility: Nomination by a department chair, advisor, professor or research scientist (any institution worldwide); no self-nominations.
For the 2027–2030 cycle: PhD received between 1 January 2025 and 31 August 2027, with no more than two years of postdoc experience.
A UC Berkeley faculty host support letter and three references are required.
programmes.nationalities: Any nationality; non-US citizens must be eligible for J-1 Scholar status (H-1B is not supported).
programmes.funding: Stipend $95,000 with 3% annual increases, plus $10,000 a year research fund (about $378,000 total value with benefits).

dates.deadlineNote: Nominations for 2027–2030 closed on 10 September 2026. Dates for the next cycle are not yet published.

procedure: Ask a professor or department chair to nominate you.
If nominated, submit the full application with references and a Berkeley faculty host letter.

verification.notes: From the Miller Institute fellowship page (2027–2030 cycle).

warnings: Amounts are from the 2025 call and may change in the next call.
programmes.title: TÜBİTAK 2232-B International Fellowship for Early Stage Researchers
programmes.summary: Two- to three-year research fellowships with a research budget and team scholarships for early-career researchers moving to Türkiye.
programmes.location: Universities, public research centres and R&D companies in Türkiye
eligibility: Under 40 on the call opening date (one extra year per birth for women).
PhD within the last 4 years with at least 1 year of postdoc research abroad, or 4 years of full-time research abroad as defined in the call.
Not lived in Türkiye more than 1 year in the last 3 years, and not working in Türkiye.
Highly Cited Researcher, or at least 12 months in the last 5 years at a qualifying top-ranked institution or company.
programmes.nationalities: Not restricted on the official page.
programmes.funding: 2025 call: coordinator scholarship TL 150,000 a month, initial research grant TL 2,350,000, project grant up to TL 3,000,000, plus family, insurance and team scholarships.

dates.deadlineNote: The 2025 call ran 27 September – 30 December 2025 and is closed. Check TÜBİTAK for the next call.

procedure: Agree a project with a host institution in Türkiye.
Apply online through TÜBİTAK’s TYBS system during the call.
If selected, start the research within 12 months of the decision.

verification.notes: From TÜBİTAK’s 2232-B programme page (2025 call).

programmes.title: FWO Junior Postdoctoral Fellowship
programmes.summary: Three-year postdoctoral fellowships at a Flemish university or research institution, with a salary and bench fee.
eligibility: PhD obtained no more than 3 years before 1 October of the start year, or completed by 15 September of that year.
A supervisor at a Flemish host institution.
Maximum two applications; not previously funded by this fellowship.
programmes.nationalities: Not restricted on the official page.
programmes.funding: Gross salary about €5,507 a month (2025 scale) plus a bench fee of €4,000–10,000 a year.

dates.deadlineNote: The 2026 call closed on 17 November 2025. Check the FWO page for the current call deadline.

procedure: Find a supervisor at a Flemish host institution.
Apply online to the most suitable FWO expert panel; your supervisor sends a recommendation.
Shortlisted applicants are interviewed by the panel.

verification.notes: From the FWO junior postdoctoral fellowship page.
